title: Methodology

batches.text: Settlement transactions a solver executed on Base in the window that filled at least one order. One auction can settle as several batches.

trades.text: User orders filled inside those batches.

volume.text: USD value of filled orders. Each trade counts at the lower of its sell and buy value, priced with the token prices CoW used in that auction and Chainlink’s ETH/USD rate at settlement.

share.text: A solver’s portion of all batches, trades or volume in the window.

gas.text: Gas units used by a solver’s settlements divided by trades filled. Units of gas, not cost.

networkAverage.text: Gas per trade across all solvers, weighted by trades.

entered.text: Share of the window’s auctions in which the solver submitted at least one solution. Only auctions that ended in a settlement count.

winRate.text: Share of the auctions a solver entered that it won, alone or with other winners.

leadingSince.text: First day of the current unbroken run in which the same solver ranked #1 by daily share.

sources.text: Settlement events and receipts on Base, CoW Protocol’s solver-competition API and Chainlink’s ETH/USD feed.

attribution.text: Settlements sent through CoW’s flash-loan router are credited to the solver that won the auction.

freshness.text: Refreshed every {minutes, plural, one {minute} other {# minutes}}. Last run {date}, {time} UTC, to block {block}.
freshness.unknown: Refreshed every {minutes, plural, one {minute} other {# minutes}}.

windows.text: Rolling, ending at the last indexed block. Longer windows add up daily windows; rates are averaged per auction.

names.text: From CoW’s public solver registry, checked against the on-chain allow-list. Solvers without a public name are shown by address.

disclosure: Fiberscope is built by Fibrous, which also runs a solver on CoW Protocol. Every solver, Fibrous included, is measured by the same open-source code.
